provenance.method: executed the reference package in a source checkout with a Python environment; a build worktree has none and cannot reproduce this

env.note: SOLSTONE_JOURNAL pinned to a scratch path because get_journal() AUTO-CREATES the journal directory

provenance.guard: capture refuses non-zero on any importer-loader warning or any count mismatch; get_file_importers() otherwise drops rows silently at exit 0

routing_contract.rule: detect_file_importer iterates the registry in insertion order and returns the FIRST importer whose detect() matches
routing_contract.why_it_matters: six importers claim *.zip, so insertion order decides which one receives an owner's archive. A hash-ordered native registry routes zips nondeterministically.

unknown_option_exit_codes.note: MEASURED IN FOUR ENVIRONMENTS. The exit is a property of whether solstone is running, NOT of the grammar. --nonsense reaching the parser yields 2 from the missing required positional, so the native probe's expected exit 2 is a MATCH, not a divergence.

solstone_down.cause: require_solstone() gate fires before argument validation

supervisor_gate_passed.cause: parser.error on the missing required positional 'media'
